sloka: अलमस्मात् परित्रातुं राघवाद्राक्षसीगणम् ।अभियाचाम वैदेहीमेतद्धि मम रोचते ।। ५.५८.८७ ।।।।
transliteration: alamasmāt paritrātuṁ rāghavādrākṣasīgaṇam ।abhiyācāma vaidehīmetaddhi mama rocate ।। 5.58.87 ।।।।

translations.english: 'To protect the demon clan from destruction by Rama, it is enough if we beg her (pardon). Indeed, I think that way.
